user.title: User
user.description: Public profile of a Scavenger Hunt player, tracking points and completions

id.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the player

username.description: Unique display nickname chosen by the user

score.description: Total earned score from approved submissions

completedCount.description: Total count of approved scavenger hunt items completed

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the player profile was initiated

submission.title: Submission
submission.description: A single photo hunt submission made by a player to complete an item

id.description: Unique auto-generated ID for this submission

userId.description: The UID of the user who made the submission

username.description: The username of the submitting user at submission time

itemId.description: The ID of the scavenger hunt item being hunted

imageUrl.description: Optimized base64 photographic proof of the hunt item

status.description: Status of the proof: pending review, verified by AI/Admin, or rejected

aiExplanation.description: Explanatory feedback generated by the Gemini verification agent

item.title: Item
item.description: A single huntable mission description with criteria and scores

title.description: The title of the item or mission

description.description: Detailed prompt describing what the user must locate and photograph

points.description: Number of points awarded upon approved completion

category.description: Classification category like Nature, Domestic, City, Quirky

icon.description: Lucide icon string name to display on the checklist

/users/{userId}.description: Scavenger Hunt players and leaderboard state

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Photo submission proofs submitted by scavenger hunt participants
